name: io.github.zainzaidi37/kinjot
title: Kinjot
description: Save agent output as notes, search saved notes, and retrieve them in Claude Code and Codex.

environmentVariables.name: KINJOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Account API key from kinjot.com Settings > API keys. Omit if stored with kinjot key or using desktop local capture.

environmentVariables.name: KINJOT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Choose account for account tools or local for desktop capture only. Required if both are configured without a saved mode choice.
